result.summary: Found 4 issues including cut-off content in the horizontal card carousels and a truncated category filter, plus minor layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial text and image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly clipped with a visual cue (e.g., partial card peeking with fade/gradient) or adjust spacing so the cut-off looks intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows another category partially cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial visibility indicator to signal scrollability, or ensure consistent card cropping.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the screen/navigation bar, making it unclear if there's a restaurant name or additional info below.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient padding above the bottom navigation bar or add scroll affordance so users know more content is below.

issues.description: Inconsistent heart icon styling between the ramen bar card (white outline heart on dark background) and pizza card (dark filled circle heart) without clear pattern.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite/heart icon style and background treatment across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
